title: The Thank-You Parade
author: Claude
blurb: The wind has scattered the school band and the class's thank-you cards on the morning of the town's parade. Penny, the drum major in the tall plumed hat, sets it right: find the tuba player's mouthpiece in a leaf pile, the drummer's sticks up a tree and a flute in the duck pond, catch the cards before the gust runs out, help the fire hall crew build the float, keep in step with the squirting puddles, hand a card to every neighbor on the curb, and climb the stage as the whole town waves. A Special from Sandbox Software, around Veterans Day.
